01

Face Recognition System

Machine Learning · Python

Implemented a face recognition system using PCA and LDA for dimensionality reduction on the ORL face dataset. Applied KNN for classification and evaluated different parameters and train/test splits.

Machine LearningComputer VisionPCALDAKNN
02

Smart Parking & Navigation Robot

Embedded Systems · C · Proteus

Developed an autonomous mobile robot capable of line tracking and obstacle detection using sensor-based navigation. Implemented line-following algorithms and ultrasonic obstacle detection.

Embedded CSensorsRoboticsProteus
03

Enterprise Network Design

Cisco Packet Tracer

Designed a multi-branch enterprise network for six interconnected locations. Configured VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, DHCP, DNS, Web and Mail services, OSPF, static routing, subnetting, and IP addressing.

NetworkingVLANsOSPFRoutingCisco Packet Tracer
04

Audio Equalizer

Signal Processing · MATLAB

Implemented a multi-band audio equalizer using digital filtering techniques. Applied FIR/IIR filter design and frequency-domain analysis to process audio frequency components.

MATLABDSPFIRIIRSignal Processing
05

Bank Management System

Software Development · Java

Developed a console-based banking application supporting account creation, deposits, withdrawals, and balance inquiries for multiple users. Applied OOP principles including encapsulation and inheritance.

JavaOOPSoftware Development
06

Car Agency Database System

Database Engineering · SQL / MySQL

Designed a normalized relational database for a car dealership system with interconnected tables covering inventory, customers, and transactions. Created SQL queries using JOINs, subqueries, and aggregations.

SQLMySQLDatabase DesignData Management
